symptom.name: Pump does not start
symptom.description: The pump does not start when power is applied.

failure_modes.name: Blown motor fuse
failure_modes.description: The 10 A motor fuse is blown.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the 10 A motor fuse
corrective_actions.description: Replace the blown motor fuse and restart the pump.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Replace the 10 A motor fuse, close the fuse holder, and restart the pump.

symptom.name: Low discharge pressure
symptom.description: Discharge pressure is below the expected value.

failure_modes.name: Clogged inlet filter
failure_modes.description: The inlet filter is clogged and restricts flow.

corrective_actions.name: Remove and wash the inlet filter
corrective_actions.description: Clean the clogged inlet filter and verify discharge pressure.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Remove the inlet filter, wash it with clean water, reinstall it, and run a pressure test.
